classes.name: BRepClass_Edge
classes.summary: This class is used to send the description of an Edge to the classifier. It contains an Edge and a Face. So the PCurve of the Edge can be found.

instanceMethods.name: Edge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current Edge.

instanceMethods.name: Face
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Face for the current Edge.

instanceMethods.name: NextEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the next Edge.

instanceMethods.name: SetNextEdge
instanceMethods.comment: Finds and sets the next Edge for the current.

instanceMethods.name: MaxTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the maximum tolerance.

instanceMethods.name: SetMaxTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the maximum tolerance at which to start checking in the intersector.

instanceMethods.name: UseBndBox
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if we are using boxes in the intersector.

instanceMethods.name: SetUseBndBox
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the status of whether we are using boxes or not.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (theF: TopoDS_Face, theP: gp_Pnt2d, theTol: number, theUseBndBox?: boolean, theGapCheckTol?: number)
constructors.comment: Creates an algorithm to classify the Point P with Tolerance <T> on the face <F>. Recommended to use {@link Bnd_Box | `Bnd_Box`} if the number of edges > 10 and the geometry is mostly spline.

instanceMethods.name: Rejected
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True when the state was computed by a rejection. The state is OUT.

instanceMethods.name: NoWires
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the face contains no wire. The state is IN.

instanceMethods.name: Edge
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Edge used to determine the classification. When the State is ON this is the Edge containing the point.

instanceMethods.name: EdgeParameter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the parameter on `Edge()` used to determine the classification.

instanceMethods.name: Position
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the position of the point on the edge returned by Edge.
